camel_example: aliyun csas CreatePrivateAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --UserGroupMode Normal --Status Enabled --ApplicationType Application --Priority 1 --PolicyAction Allow --Name private_access_policy_name
description_zh: 创建当前阿里云账号下内网访问策略
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-private-access-policy --name private_access_policy_name --policy-action Allow --application-type Application --user-group-mode Normal --status Enabled --priority 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrivateAccessPolicy

parameters.help_en: Name of the private access policy. The length is 1 to 128 characters, supporting Chinese and uppercase and lowercase English letters, and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 这是一条内网访问策略
parameters.help_en: Description of the private access policy. The length is 1 to 128 characters, supporting Chinese and uppercase and lowercase English letters, and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Action of the private access policy. Values:
Block: Block.
Allow: Allow
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许
parameters.name: policy_action

parameters.help_en:
Application type of the private access policy. Values:
Application: Application.
Tag: Tag
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
Application：应用。
Tag：标签
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: Set of application IDs for the private access policy. Up to 100 application IDs can be entered. Required when ApplicationType is Application. Mutually exclusive with TagIds
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问应用ID。当ApplicationType为Application时，必填。和TagIds互斥
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: Set of tag IDs for the private access policy. Up to 100 tag IDs can be entered. Required when ApplicationType is Tag. Mutually exclusive with ApplicationIds
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入100个内网访问标签ID。当ApplicationType为Tag时，必填。和ApplicationIds互斥
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en:
User group type of the private access policy. Values:
Normal: Normal user group.
Custom: Custom user group
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
Normal：普通用户组。
Custom：自定义用户组
parameters.name: user_group_mode

parameters.help_en: Set of user group IDs for the private access policy. Required when the user group type is Normal. Mutually exclusive with the custom user group set. Up to 2000 user group IDs can be entered
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的用户组ID集合，当用户组类型为Normal时，必填。和自定义用户组集合互斥。最多可输入2000个用户组ID
parameters.name: user_group_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the identity source for the custom user group. Required when the custom user group type is department
fields.help_zh: 自定义用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，必填
fields.name: idp_id

fields.help_en:
Relation of the custom user group. Values:
Equal: Equal.
Unequal: Not equal
fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于
fields.name: relation

fields.help_en:
Type of the custom user group. Values:
username: Username.
department: Department.
email: Email.
telephone: Telephone
fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机
fields.name: user_group_type

fields.help_en:
Value of the custom user group attribute.
When the user group type is username, it represents the value of the username. The length is 1 to 128 characters, supporting Chinese and uppercase and lowercase English letters, and can include numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at (@) symbols, and spaces.
When the user group type is department, it represents the value of the department. For example: OU=Department1,OU=SASE DingTalk.
When the user group type is email, it represents the value of the email. For example: username@example.com.
When the user group type is telephone, it represents the value of the telephone. For example: 13900001234
fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Set of custom user groups for the private access policy. Required when the user group type is Custom. Mutually exclusive with the user group ID set. Up to 10 custom user groups can be entered
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的自定义用户组集合，当用户组类型为Custom时，必填。和用户组ID集合互斥。最多可输入10个自定义用户组
parameters.name: custom_user_attributes

parameters.help_en:
The status of the private access policy. Values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The priority of the private access policy. The number 1 indicates the highest priority. Range: 1~1000, with the maximum value being the total number of private access policies
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1~1000，最大值为内网访问策略总数
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security baseline policy
parameters.help_zh: 安全基线策略的ID
parameters.name: device_attribute_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution policy for not meeting the security baseline. Values:

Block: Block.
Observe: Observe
parameters.help_zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：

Block：拦截。
Observe：观察
parameters.name: device_attribute_action

parameters.help_en: The trigger template ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发模板ID
parameters.name: trigger_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of the trusted process. Values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: trusted_process_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the trusted process group
parameters.help_zh: 可信进程组ID
parameters.name: trusted_process_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the trusted software
parameters.help_zh: 可信软件ID
parameters.name: trusted_software_ids

parameters.help_en: The start time when the zero trust policy takes effect, represented as a timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: valid_from

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the zero trust policy, in seconds timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: valid_until

parameters.help_en: Switch status for effective time. Values: - Enabled: On. - Disabled: Off
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: valid_time_status

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the private access policy

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the current request
